confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and budget-hotel anchors, which have less visible pricing and lower confidence. The FX rate comes from search-result text that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page, and I could not confirm a 16 October 2026 RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Dominican Republic resort-area pricing, benchmarked against other Caribbean resort towns with a mix of independent and all-inclusive tourism. Lodging is adjusted upward for Punta Cana's resort-zone pricing, and food and drink are adjusted toward local Dominican prices.
